name: Coldwater Heritage Partnership Grant

funder.name: Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission, DCNR and Pennsylvania Trout Unlimited (Coldwater Heritage Partnership)

summary: Grants to non-profit groups, conservation districts, municipalities and local Trout Unlimited chapters to develop Coldwater Conservation Plans that identify problems and opportunities for protecting Pennsylvania's coldwater streams.

applicant_types.quote: awards grants of up to $5,000 annually to non-profit organizations such as watershed groups, conservation districts, municipalities and local chapters of Trout Unlimited.

geography.quote: funding support for the evaluation, conservation and protection of Pennsylvania's coldwater streams.
